# Color Swap Puzzle

A pixel puzzle on a 4x4 grid of colored tiles. Click two adjacent tiles to swap them. The goal is to make every row a single color. A swap counter tracks your moves, and a "Solved!" message appears when you win. The Shuffle button starts a new puzzle.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Features

- 4x4 grid of colored tiles (red, blue, green, yellow)
- Click two adjacent tiles to swap them
- Swap counter
- "Solved!" message when every row has a single color
- Shuffle button to start a new puzzle
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive design that works from 360px wide

## Built With

- HTML5
- CSS3 (flexbox, grid, gradients)
- Plain JavaScript (no libraries or frameworks)
